sentences.en: Asakura Keita was born on March 5, 1973. When he was five years old, his father was elected to the Fukuoka Prefectural Assembly, and three years later, he became a member of the House of Representatives. His older brother, Masaya-san, was raised early on as his father's successor, but Keita lived a life unrelated to politics, belonging to the astronomy club throughout middle and high school. The reason he went all the way from Fukuoka to Shinshu University was that he wanted to live in a place with beautiful stars.

sentences.en: "Asakura Keita received 127,312 votes. Mr. Tokubana Kiyomitsu received 127,148 votes. With a mere difference of 164 votes, the election of Candidate Asakura has been decided."

sentences.ruby: 「頑張れ、朝倉先生[あさくらせんせい]」
